461:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All right, here I go! Let's give it our all again today...」

461:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Louder! Do you think customers will come with a voice like that!」

461:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Once more! Let's give it our all again today...!」

461:t_10:45.en:
$$ランド$$
「And then, on top of that, a smile!」

461:t_10:47.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Employee training is all well and good, but...」

461:t_10:48.en:
$$青山$$
「Looks like this will pile stifling heat on top of $$赤木$$'s fighting spirit and hot-bloodedness.」

462:t_000:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「So you showed up, robot army! I'm not going easy on you today!」

462:t_000:2.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「He's the only one who got to enjoy his free time to the fullest, after all. He'd better work that much harder to make up for it.」

462:t_000:3.en:
$$恵子$$
「You went out with $$正太郎$$, it looked like. Where did you go?」

462:t_000:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Talk later! First we protect Tokyo!」

462:t_000:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It doesn't look like $$ワッ太$$ and $$赤木$$ and the others are here, though...」

462:t_000:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then there's no need to worry.」

462:t_000:7.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$トライダー$$ and $$ダイ・ガード$$ will be joining us shortly!」

462:t_000:8.en:
$$厚井$$
「When that happens, you're going to be astonished.」

462:t_000:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... Sorry, but there's no part for $$ワッ太$$ today. I'll take care of the enemy myself.」

462:t_000:10.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's the spirit. Well then, shall we go?」

462:t_001:1.en:
$n
「Right now I'm focusing on what's in front of me. Thinking about $$陣代高校$$ can wait until later.」

462:t_001:2.en:
$$甲児$$
(That day... in the battle at $$第２新東京市$$, everyone must have learned about our fight...)

462:t_001:3.en:
$n
(I'll apologize someday for deceiving everyone... So for now, let's fight to protect Japan.)

462:t_002:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$２１世紀警備保障$$ is evacuating the citizens, but we need to end this battle as soon as possible.」

462:t_002:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Roger! We're not letting a bunch of who-knows-what have their way with the only peaceful Japan we have left!」

462:t_002:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here I come, robot army! You machines that turned on humanity, I'm taking every one of you down!」

462:t_003:0.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Everyone, it looks like the President and $$赤木$$ and the others have arrived.」

462:t_004:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! Behold, the reborn New $$トライダー$$!」

462:t_004:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's that supposed to be? Sounds like Uncle $$アムロ$$'s $$ガンダム$$.」

462:t_004:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready to be amazed, $$勝平$$! We replaced all of $$トライダー$$'s armor with 《$$ガバールニウム$$》!」

462:t_004:5.en:
$$厚井$$
「It's the armor material from $$トライダー$$'s design stage.」

462:t_004:6.en:
$$厚井$$
「It's such a precious metal that there was no replacing it, and once we started operating $$トライダー$$ at our company, we swapped out almost all of it for ordinary materials.」

462:t_004:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「In other words, the $$トライダー$$ you see now is the true $$トライダー$$.」

462:t_004:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The power is so great that even I, the one riding it, get so shocked my eyeballs nearly pop out!」

462:t_004:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「How did you get your hands on such a precious metal?」

462:t_004:10.en:
$$厚井$$
「According to Director $$大塚$$, an anonymous collaborator brought it in.」

462:t_004:13.en:
$$勝平$$
(So this is the power Uncle said he entrusted to $$ワッ太$$!)

462:t_004:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「And how did $$赤木$$'s side go?」

462:t_004:15.en:
$$赤木$$
「All set! $$ダイ・ガード$$ has been powered up with a thorough overhaul too!」

462:t_004:16.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「And that's not all. We re-forged the $$グレートノットパニッシャー$$'s bunker with $$ガバールニウム$$.」

462:t_004:19.en:
$$青山$$
「You mean you used $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$'s materials without permission!?」

462:t_004:20.en:
$$墨田$$
「T-that's bad, $$里香$$-chan! We agreed to keep that a secret...」

462:t_004:21.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Now, now... The Earth is in trouble, so let's just call it helping each other out.」

462:t_004:22.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「We helped with $$トライダー$$'s refit, so let's call it even.」

462:t_004:23.en:
$$柿小路$$
「By any measure, it looks like our company is the one taking the loss...」

462:t_004:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't sweat it either, Executive Director! We'll make it back with hard work from here on!」

462:t_004:25.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Actually... that's just the thing. The costs of this refit have piled up beyond what I imagined...」

462:t_004:26.en:
$$赤木$$
「You're worried about the company coffers even at a time like this!?」

462:t_004:27.en:
$$木下$$
「What are you saying, Mr. Red Ink!? Unlike $$２１世紀警備保障$$, a small outfit like ours turns $$赤木$$ the moment we let our guard down!」

462:t_004:28.en:
$$青山$$
「Calm down, $$木下$$. You've got 'red ink' and $$赤木$$ backwards.」

462:t_004:29.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Oh... but that might actually be a fitting way to put it.」

462:t_004:31.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「The cost of this Punisher refit... it's been decided the bill goes to PR Section 2.」

462:t_004:33.en:
$$青山$$
「So you're telling us PR Section 2 has to pay that bill all by itself!?」

462:t_004:34.en:
$$青山$$
「If that happens, our section is guaranteed to end up deep in the red!!」

462:t_004:35.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$青山$$ is just like $$クロウ$$...」

462:t_004:36.en:
$$ダリー$$
「I thought it was just the short-straw luck, but he's turned out similar in that department too.」

462:t_004:38.en:
$$いぶき$$
「It's not a laughing matter! At this rate PR Section 2 will be deep in the $$赤木$$!」

462:t_004:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「I-Ibuki, you calm down too! Ca-calm, calm down! I'm the red ink... and the enemy is $$赤木$$...!」

462:t_004:40.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The PR Section 2 folks sure are weak against red ink, huh.」

462:t_004:41.en:
$$木下$$
「We're used to it, though. Red ink? Bring it on.」

462:t_004:42.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$木下$$...! What a man you are!」

462:t_004:43.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$... Shall we grant our usual special exception here?」

462:t_004:45.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$赤木$$... For this time only, the funds your team has earned will be treated as performance pay as they are.」

462:t_004:47.en:
$$青山$$
「Executive Director, please do the calculation!」

462:t_004:48.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Done! If Team 'Salaryman' earns 50000 in funds, the deficit is cleared!」

462:t_004:49.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「All right! If we know that much...!」

里香.evidence: Given-name form of 百目鬼里香 (Rika Domeki, sheet); Sumita calls her 里香ちゃん.
